```suggestion
	static void get_variant_constant_list(const StringName &p_class, Vector<String> &p_constants, bool p_no_inheritance = false);
```
New code should use `Vector` or `LocalVector` unless there's some specific reason not to, here `Vector` should be more appropriate, also when the argument is non-optional it should use reference I'd say

```suggestion
					d2["name"] = F;
```
Unnecessary and misleads what the type is I'd say
